Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Revantage Opportunity with Revantage-AI and Data Engineer Bengaluru 3 - 7 years 15.0 lacs - 27.5 lacs In office Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Data Engineering Apply now Job description AI and Data Engineer Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Japans (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company? AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow. Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning… Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground. A Snapshot As an AI & Data Engineer at AirTrunk, you will contribute to the design, build, and operation of the data and AI systems that power our next-generation platforms. You’ll work across data engineering, AI engineering, and platform technologies to develop scalable and reliable solutions that support operational efficiency, sustainability, and intelligent decision-making across our data centre and business ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer with a solid foundation in software and data engineering who is looking to deepen their experience in modern data platforms and applied AI. You will work closely with senior engineers and platform teams to build production-ready data pipelines, AI solutions, and platform capabilities while continuing to grow your technical skills. Your Day to Day AI Engineering & Applications Support the development and deployment of AI and ML solutions that enhance AirTrunk’s operations, including automation and predictive use cases. Assist in building and integrating LLM-based applications and workflows using tools such as OpenAI, Databricks, or LangChain. Contribute to the development of simple agentic or automation solutions under guidance from senior engineers. Help test, evaluate, and improve model performance and outputs. Data Engineering & Pipelines Build, maintain, and optimise batch and streaming data pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases. Develop and test data transformations using tools such as dbt and SQL to create clean, reliable, and reusable datasets. Assist in integrating data from various enterprise systems into the AI & Data Platform. Support data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to ensure trusted and consistent data. Platform & Engineering Practices Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows for data and AI solutions using tools such as Git, Terraform, and Docker. Follow established engineering standards, patterns, and best practices to ensure quality, reliability, and maintainability. Assist with deployment, configuration, and support of data and AI workloads in cloud environments such as Azure and Databricks. Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving team engineering practices. MLOps, DataOps & Observability Support the implementation of MLOps and DataOps practices, including deployment, monitoring, and basic lifecycle management of data pipelines and models. Assist in setting up logging, monitoring, and alerting to ensure visibility into pipeline and model performance. Help troubleshoot issues in data pipelines and AI systems, working with senior engineers to resolve production challenges. Contribute to testing and validation processes to ensure reliability and accuracy. Collaboration & Learning Collaborate with other engineers to deliver integrated, production-ready solutions. Work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical tasks. Actively learn from senior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing within the Data & AI team. Continuously build skills in data engineering, AI technologies, and cloud platforms. Requirements 3 to 5 years’ experience in data engineering, software engineering, or AI/ML engineering, with exposure to building data or AI solutions in a cloud environment. Foundational experience building and maintaining data pipelines, with familiarity in batch and streaming processing concepts. Experience working with SQL and Python for data processing, transformation, and basic application development. Exposure to modern data platforms and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Kafka, or similar technologies. Basic understanding of data modelling concepts and data architecture patterns such as lakehouse or medallion architecture. Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools, with some experience building or integrating machine learning or LLM-based solutions. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, and an understanding of deploying applications or data workflows in the cloud. Understanding of software engineering best practices including version control (Git), testing, and code quality. Exposure to CI/CD, containerisation (Docker), or infrastructure as code (Terraform) is beneficial but not required. Awareness of data quality, governance, and security considerations in building data and AI solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. The AirTrunk Culture Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential. The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive. Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged. Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Digital Crown It Systems Llp Ai Ml Engineer Pune, Delhi / NCR, Mumbai (All Areas) 3 - 8 years Not Disclosed In office Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask, Docker, Kubernetes, K8s, AWS SageMaker, SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Vertex AI, Azure ML, Azure Machine Learning, Spark, Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, Apache Kafka, SQL, LLM, Large Language Models, Generative AI, GenAI, RAG, Feast Apply now Job description About the Role We are looking for a results-driven AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy machine learning models that solve real-world business problems at scale. You will work closely with data engineers, product teams, and cloud architects to move models from experimentation to production handling everything from feature engineering and training to inference infrastructure and monitoring. Key Responsibilities Design and implement ML models (classification, regression, clustering, NLP, computer vision) using Python and popular ML frameworks Build end-to-end ML pipelines: data ingestion, preprocessing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, and deployment Deploy models to production on AWS/GCP/Azure using Docker, Kubernetes, or managed ML services (SageMaker, Vertex AI) Monitor model performance in production, set up drift detection, and manage retraining pipelines Collaborate with data engineers to ensure clean, versioned, and reproducible data pipelines Write clean, modular, and well-documented code following software engineering best practices Conduct A/B experiments, analyse results statistically, and drive data-informed decisions Stay current with research developments and evaluate applicability of new techniques to the product Must-Have Skills & Experience Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn Solid understanding of ML fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning Experience deploying models to production REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask), Docker containers, cloud ML services Familiarity with data pipelines and big-data tools: Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or equivalent Working knowledge of cloud platforms: AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML Proficiency with SQL and experience working with structured and unstructured data 3+ years of hands-on ML engineering experience (not just academic / Kaggle) Good to Have Experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, or fine-tuning open-source models MLOps tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Weights & Biases Knowledge of feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and model registries Domain experience in BFSI, e-commerce, or healthcare Education B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field. Equivalent experience accepted for candidates with strong portfolios. messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, you're invited to apply to this job Birla Institute Of Technology And Science Assistant Professor Bengaluru 4 - 9 years Not Disclosed Hybrid Deep Learning, MLOps, Data Science, GenAI, NLP, Devops, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence Apply now Job description Post / Job Title: Assistant Professor Job Type: Full Time No. of Positions : 3 Department : Academic Location: Bangalore Role Overview: The incumbent will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering high-quality, industry-aligned educational content for our online courses and programmes. The role will include curriculum development, teaching, assessment, and ensuring the overall quality of programme delivery. Faculty members will also manage a large pool of guest/adjunct faculty and teaching assistants, ensuring consistency and excellence in course execution. Principal Accountabilities & Responsibilities Assist in the development of industry-aligned curricula under the guidance of senior faculty or programme directors. Teach and facilitate courses, focusing on delivering engaging learning experiences such as project-based learning. Grade assignments and assessments, providing timely feedback to students. Participate in guest/adjunct faculty coordination, helping ensure programme quality in collaboration with senior faculty. Collaborate with peers to improve courses and engage in departmental activities as appropriate. Stay up-to-date with developments and trends in relevant industries to ensure that courses reflect the most current practices, technologies, and skills. Skill and Ability Requirements Expertise in at least one of the following domain areas: Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, MLOps Strong programming skills in Python or R, with experience in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML models, and model monitoring. Familiarity with MLOps and ML workflow orchestration tools. Experience using cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML) would be an added advantage. LLMs, GenAI, Agentic AI, MLOps Strong programming skills in Python or R, with experience in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn). Experience in developing LLM, GenAI or Agentic AI applications. Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including CI/CD for ML models, and model monitoring. Familiarity with MLOps and ML workflow orchestration tools. Knowledge of learning in LLMs, LLM distillation, Multiagent LLM, Multimodal LLMs, Reasoning in LLMs would be an added advantage. Cloud computing, DevOps Experience using Docker and Kubernetes. Application deployment on the cloud, cloud deployment models. Experience in containerization and microservices (using YAML manifests for deployment and service objects). Scripting and automating cloud API interactions would be an added advantage. SW Application Development, Cloud Native Application Development, DevOps Strong programming skills in Python, full stack application development, microservices DevOps tools and pipeline. Key Competencies Ability to quickly adapt teaching methods and content to meet evolving industry standards and learner needs. Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to work across diverse teams, including guest/adjunct faculty and administrative staff. Passion for student success and a commitment to providing high-quality education to diverse learners. Capacity to identify challenges in programme delivery and student outcomes and propose innovative solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and motivate students in an online setting. Qualification & Experience Qualification Required Qualifications Technical expertise in at least one of the following areas: data science, machine learning, GenAI, NLP, deep learning, AI lifecycle, MLOps, AI governance, cyber security, cloud computing, DevOps, intelligence user interfaces, software application development Masters or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science/Data Science/allied fields from a reputed institution. Comfortable with the use of online tools and/or learning platforms. Experience Minimum 3 years of work experience, preferably in the IT industry. Experience in project management or managing teams. Active engagement with professional associations or networks in the relevant field. Previous experience in a programme management or faculty coordination role. Industry type Education / Training Department Teaching & Training Role Teaching & Training - Other Employment type Full Time, Permanent Education Any Doctorate, Ph.D/Doctorate You are receiving this e-mail because your profile contained one or more of the following words that the recruiter searched on : "cloud computing, cyber security, Data science engineer, MI Engineer, Gen AL, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Data Science, MLOps" Apply now India’s first career-focused content feed The sender of this email is registered with Naukri.com as Birla Institute Of Technology And Science (Building No./Flat No.: Bits Pilani Campus, Road/St reet: Vidya Vihar, City/Town/Village: Pilani, Dist rict: Jhunjhunu, State: Rajasthan, Pin Code: 333031, PILANI, Rajasthan, India). thread_messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Hiring for Foreign MNC Posted by Ultimate Search Agentic AI Developer - with one of the Big 4 consulting firms Bengaluru, Bangalore Rural 3 - 8 years Not Disclosed In office Agentic AI, Machine Learning, Python, ML, Deep Learning, GenAI Apply now Job description Dear Candidate , Greetings ! At present we have multiple urgent opening with Deloitte . Job Title: Agentic AI Developer Consultant and Senior Consultant Please Note: The candidates would be under the direct payroll of RVAI Global and would be deployed to the client site Deloitte Job Location : Bangalore (Work From Office), General shift timings Experience : Agentic AI Developer – Consultant : 3 to 5 years, Senior Consultant : 5 to 8 years Work you’ll do Understand the business use case, conduct preliminary analysis and propose potential solutions using statistical and Agentic AI / ML techniques to solve the client’s problems. Perform feasibility analysis of proposed solutions through data exploration and building proof of concept using Agentic AI/ ML etc. Supervise and train a team of consultants in building GenAI/ Agentic AI Platform. Work in a highly collaborative atmosphere of consultants and team leaders from different geographic locations. Mentor team members and guide them as a technical and business SME and help them grow in their career. Serve as a mentor for career navigation and skills development for consultants in the broader organization who are not direct reports on your immediate team. Update your knowledge base with AI/ML advances Key Responsibilities Product Development: Lead the ideation, incubation, and scaling of innovative AI/ML products, ensuring alignment with business goals and client needs. Technical Leadership: Supervise and train a team of consultants in building advanced GenAI Product using large volumes of structured, semi-structured, and chaotic data. Prompt Engineering and Optimization: Develop and refine prompt engineering techniques to enhance model performance and user interaction. GenAI and Agent Architecture: Design and implement Generative AI applications using both open-source and closed-source Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on agent architecture and integration. Collaboration: Work in a highly collaborative atmosphere with consultants and team leaders from different geographic locations, providing expert reviews and guidance. Qualifications and Required Skills Develop, review, and implement Solutions applying AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and develop APIs using Python. Understanding and working knowledge of Agentic Skills and Deep Agent Frameworks Understanding and working knowledge of Agentic AI, Agent Development Frameworks like LangGraph/ LangChain. Lead the development and implementation of Generative AI applications using both open source (Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc.) and closed source (Open AI GPT models, Claude, Cohere etc.) Large Language Models (LLMS). Extensively work with advanced models such as GPT-3.5, GPT 4, Llama, BERT etc, for natural language processing and creative content generation using contextual information. Design and optimize solutions leveraging Vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of contextual data for LLMs. RAG and Guardrails: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation techniques and establish guardrails to ensure the reliability and safety of AI models. Basic knowledge of Pre-Training / Finetuning Basic knowledge of MCP and A2A Minimum of 4-5 years of programming in Python Knowledge of RDBMS – Postgress / MySQL and NoSQL Databases. Provide expert reviews for all projects within the assigned subject. Ability to communicate with cross functional/competencies teams. A passion for leading a team of consultants and help them grow in their careers. Strong communication and critical thinking skills. Should have Bachelor’s degree or greater in Engineering/Computer Science/Statistics/Mathematics or other quantitative field Good to have Cloud knowledge (AWS/ GCP or Azure). Deployment Knowledge – docker and Kubernetes. As a Databricks partner , V4C is a Databricks-first company that helps businesses use data and AI more effectively. messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Revantage Opportunity with Revantage-AI and Data Engineer Bengaluru 3 - 7 years 15.0 lacs - 27.5 lacs In office Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Data Engineering Apply now Job description AI and Data Engineer Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Japans (APJ) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company? AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow. Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning… Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground. A Snapshot As an AI & Data Engineer at AirTrunk, you will contribute to the design, build, and operation of the data and AI systems that power our next-generation platforms. You’ll work across data engineering, AI engineering, and platform technologies to develop scalable and reliable solutions that support operational efficiency, sustainability, and intelligent decision-making across our data centre and business ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer with a solid foundation in software and data engineering who is looking to deepen their experience in modern data platforms and applied AI. You will work closely with senior engineers and platform teams to build production-ready data pipelines, AI solutions, and platform capabilities while continuing to grow your technical skills. Your Day to Day AI Engineering & Applications Support the development and deployment of AI and ML solutions that enhance AirTrunk’s operations, including automation and predictive use cases. Assist in building and integrating LLM-based applications and workflows using tools such as OpenAI, Databricks, or LangChain. Contribute to the development of simple agentic or automation solutions under guidance from senior engineers. Help test, evaluate, and improve model performance and outputs. Data Engineering & Pipelines Build, maintain, and optimise batch and streaming data pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases. Develop and test data transformations using tools such as dbt and SQL to create clean, reliable, and reusable datasets. Assist in integrating data from various enterprise systems into the AI & Data Platform. Support data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to ensure trusted and consistent data. Platform & Engineering Practices Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows for data and AI solutions using tools such as Git, Terraform, and Docker. Follow established engineering standards, patterns, and best practices to ensure quality, reliability, and maintainability. Assist with deployment, configuration, and support of data and AI workloads in cloud environments such as Azure and Databricks. Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving team engineering practices. MLOps, DataOps & Observability Support the implementation of MLOps and DataOps practices, including deployment, monitoring, and basic lifecycle management of data pipelines and models. Assist in setting up logging, monitoring, and alerting to ensure visibility into pipeline and model performance. Help troubleshoot issues in data pipelines and AI systems, working with senior engineers to resolve production challenges. Contribute to testing and validation processes to ensure reliability and accuracy. Collaboration & Learning Collaborate with other engineers to deliver integrated, production-ready solutions. Work closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical tasks. Actively learn from senior team members and contribute to knowledge sharing within the Data & AI team. Continuously build skills in data engineering, AI technologies, and cloud platforms. Requirements 3 to 5 years’ experience in data engineering, software engineering, or AI/ML engineering, with exposure to building data or AI solutions in a cloud environment. Foundational experience building and maintaining data pipelines, with familiarity in batch and streaming processing concepts. Experience working with SQL and Python for data processing, transformation, and basic application development. Exposure to modern data platforms and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Kafka, or similar technologies. Basic understanding of data modelling concepts and data architecture patterns such as lakehouse or medallion architecture. Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools, with some experience building or integrating machine learning or LLM-based solutions. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, and an understanding of deploying applications or data workflows in the cloud. Understanding of software engineering best practices including version control (Git), testing, and code quality. Exposure to CI/CD, containerisation (Docker), or infrastructure as code (Terraform) is beneficial but not required. Awareness of data quality, governance, and security considerations in building data and AI solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. The AirTrunk Culture Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential. The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive. Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged. Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale. messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job Hiring for Indian MNC Posted by Talentbridge Gen AI Engineer Bengaluru 3 - 5 years 30.0 lacs - 35.0 lacs Hybrid Generative Ai, Machine Learning, Python, multimodal, autogen, Crewai, Langchain, Langgraph, pinecone, weaviate Apply now Job description Job Title: Generative AI Engineer Location: Bangalore Experience: 3-5 Years About the Role: We are looking for a passionate Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy next-generation AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building production-grade AI systems, multi-agent workflows, and multimodal AI solutions across text, audio, image, and video use cases. Key Responsibilities: Design and implement Agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK, Semantic Kernel, or similar. Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, ChromaDB, Qdrant, or Milvus. Develop scalable AI applications leveraging GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other foundation models. Create multi-agent workflows with tool calling, memory management, reasoning chains, and orchestration capabilities. Build multimodal AI solutions involving text, audio, image, and video understanding or generation. Develop AI microservices using Python, FastAPI, Docker, and cloud-native architectures. Implement model evaluation, observability, guardrails, and performance monitoring frameworks. Collaborate with product, platform, and engineering teams to deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions. Stay updated with advancements in LLMs, Agentic AI, Multimodal AI, and open-source GenAI ecosystems. Required Skills: 35 years of experience in AI/ML Engineering, including hands-on experience in Generative AI. Strong proficiency in Python. messages.body: <external_source>Job invite from recruiter. Apply now! You've been chosen from a large pool of jobseekers to apply for this job. Make the most of this opportunity and stay ahead in your job search. Get app Surojit Dutta, as a Naukri Pro member, you're invited to apply to this exclusive job ALLEN Career Institute 4.1 (547 Reviews) Data Scientist Bengaluru 2 - 5 years 20.0 lacs - 35.0 lacs In office Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Python, Tensorflow, Pytorch, Keras Apply now Job description JD - Data Scientist II (Computer Vision) About ALLEN Digital: At ALLEN Digital, we spearhead a technology-driven approach to education, leveraging top-tier tech talent from leading technology firms. Through our strategic collaboration with Bodhi Tree Systems, a prominent venture capital firm known for building & scaling tech-first brands, we are revolutionizing education with a tech-first approach. We address two critical challenges in the current education landscape: the need for more emphasis on holistic learning and adopting a one-size-fits-all approach. We are leveraging AI to develop an innovative ed-tech platform to provide students with a compelling end-to-end learning experience. Our goal is to transform education by providing personalized learning experiences that transcend traditional classrooms by catering to individual learning needs and to drive significant improvements in learning outcomes. Website : https://allen.in Funding News : https://yourstory.com/2023/05/allen-career-institute-online-coaching-competitive-exams-edtech Location: Bengaluru Reporting to : Chief Data Scientist Work Arrangement : Work from Office Role Overview: As a Data Scientist II (CV) at ALLEN Digital, youll apply deep learning techniques to solve real-world educational challenges and drive product innovation that enhances learning outcomes. Ideal candidates have a strong foundation in computer vision, hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks, and a passion for impactful, AI-driven solutions. Job Responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy machine learning algorithms and models, with a focus on computer vision, face recognition, emotion detection, OCR applications, etc. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project opportunities Mentor and guide junior data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning and computer vision, and apply this knowledge to drive innovation Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into actionable data-driven insights Ensure the quality and integrity of data used in model development and testing Communicate findings and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders What we are looking for: Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field A total of 2-6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in roles involving Computer Vision Proven experience as a Senior ML Scientist or a similar role, with a focus on computer vision and deep learning Strong experience in developing and deploying OCR applications Demonstrated ability to mentor junior data scientists and foster a collaborative work environment Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.) Apply now What you get as a Pro member Pro Nvites for hidden jobs Mock interviews & AI answers Power profile to boost your chances AI powered Resume maker The sender of this email is registered with Naukri.com as ALLEN Career Institute (Maruti Suzuki Driving School, CP-06 SANKALP, INDRA VIHAR, INDRA VIHAR Kota, Kota, Rajasthan , KOTA, Rajasthan, India). thread_messages.body: <external_source>Get app Dear Candidate , Greetings ! This is with reference to your interest shown and profile shared via Naukri NVite for a position of Agentic AI Developer. Please Note: The candidates would be under the direct payroll of RVAI Global and would be deployed to the client site Deloitte Plz reply to the following queries : Share alternate emergency contact number : (Should not be of the candidate, can be of anyone from the family, flat-mate/room-mate) Current Organization : Current Designation : Reason for change : Reporting to : Date of Birth : Qualification : Current CTC (Fixed + Variable) : CTC Expectation : Any other offer in hand or in process : If yes, Please mention the offer details : Official Notice Period : Are you serving the Notice period : Mention your Last Working Date : Location Staying at : Interested in Bangalore location : Expertise in Technical Skills : Total years of exp : Yrs of exp in Agentic AI Developer role : Yrs of exp in development and implementation of Generative AI applications : Yrs of exp in programming in Python : Yrs of exp in Machine Learning : Yrs of exp in Deep Learning : Yrs of exp in develop APIs using Python : Yrs of exp in open source - Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc. : Yrs of exp in closed source - Open AI GPT models, Claude, Cohere etc : Yrs of exp in Large Language Models (LLMS) : Yrs of exp in Deep Agent Frameworks : Yrs of exp in LangGraph/ LangChain : Yrs of exp in advanced models such as GPT-3.5, GPT 4, Llama, BERT : Yrs of exp in RAG and Guardrails : Yrs of exp in MCP and A2A : Yrs of exp in RDBMS Postgress / MySQL and NoSQL Databases : Ever interviewed by Deloitte in past : Thanks and Regards, Rashmi K. Vishwakarma M : 9833965671 / 9321442718 rashmi@ultimatesearch.in Ultimate Search Pvt. Ltd. messages.subject: <external_source>IITMAA Fireside Chat Series(Online) - Ep 6 - Sun 28th</external_source>
messages.snippet: <external_source>Dear Surojit Dutta, Dear Surojit Dutta, IITMAA Fireside Chats Series - Ep 6 🌟 About the Series The Fireside Chats is an initiative by IITMAA designed to bring together our alumni community for thought-</external_source>
messages.body: <external_source>Dear Surojit Dutta, IITMAA Fireside Chats Series - Ep 6 🌟 About the Series The Fireside Chats is an initiative by IITMAA designed to bring together our alumni community for thought-provoking conversations. Each session spotlights inspiring alumni and explores timely topics across economics, technology, society, and more. 📅 Date: Sunday, 28 JUN 2026 🕔10:00 AM IST | 📍 Online via Zoom 🔗 Zoom Link: Will be emailed to registered participants closer to the event.Register Now 🎙Speaker: Shri K. R. Jyothilal, IAS (BTCH '91) Additional Chief Secretary (Finance), KeralaIn Conversation With 🎤Moderator: Rajeev Srinivasan (BTEE ’78) Adjunct Faculty, IIM Bangalore | EC Member, IITMAA 🌍 Topic: IITM to IAS: Driving Development Through Strategic Initiatives 🎙 About the Speaker: Shri K. R. Jyothilal, IAS (BTCH '91), is the Additional Chief Secretary overseeing the Departments of Finance, Taxes, Public Procurement Advisory, and Planning & Economic Affairs (Rebuild Kerala Initiative), Government of Kerala. He also serves as the Chief Executive Officer of the Rebuild Kerala Initiative. An IIT Madras alumnus with a B.Tech degree and an MBA from ICFAI, Shri Jyothilal is a 1993-batch IAS officer with over three decades of distinguished public service. He has previously served as District Collector of Thiruvananthapuram and Kannur and has held leadership roles across a wide range of departments, including IT, Transport, Revenue (Devaswoms), Information & Public Relations, Printing & Stationery, Excise, Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Fisheries, Food & Civil Supplies, Tourism, Parliamentary Affairs, Ports, Aviation, General Administration, Power, and Forest & Wildlife. He has played a pivotal role in driving several transformative initiatives, including Hi-Tech Agriculture, Smart City Kochi, Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL), Kerala Metropolitan Transport Authority (KMTA), Kannur International Airport, e-Mobility, and the Hydrogen Economy, contributing significantly to Kerala's development and innovation agenda. Don’t miss this chance to learn, share, and stay connected with the IITM alumni community. 👉 Sign up today and be part of the conversation! Warm regards, IITMAA Team Upcoming IITM Alumni Meet in Tokyo, Zurich, Munich, Paris & London - Register & Join Us! Forward to your friends using WHATSAPP FACEBOOK IMPORTANT: Please do not share this mail with others, as it gives direct access to your account You received this email because you are a member of Indian Institute of Technology Madras Alumni Association - Alumni Portal. You can unsubscribe from all the mails by clicking the following link http://www.almashines.com/api/mail/unsubscribe?id=1310175&type=1&token=77740b81dc31837c2b963236dc0b30c2&cid=146</external_source>

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy data-driven solutions for lending products. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and correlations that inform business decisions on credit risk management. Provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders on strategic initiatives related to credit risk mitigation. Job Requirements : 3-9 years of experience in data science or a related field with expertise in ML/DL techniques applied to credit risk modeling. Strong understanding of statistical modeling concepts, including regression analysis, time series forecasting, etc. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python/R/SQL; experience with big data tools like Hadoop/Hive/Pig is an added advantage.
